Find the one constraint limiting the whole system's output.
Give every task an explicit ceiling on time, tokens, and spend.

Identify the chain of work that actually determines the finish date.
Find circular dependencies before they deadlock execution.
Find where time actually goes between request and delivery.
Capture a decision so a future reader understands why, not just what.
Escalate a problem as a decision someone can actually make.
Write a completion condition that can be checked by someone other than the author.
Turn a set of tasks into a valid execution order.
Find out whether this request is already answered or already in flight before spending effort.
Define what must go up, to whom, and how fast.
Find the process defects behind repeated escalations.
Build a repeatable test set that shows whether agents and skills work.
Maintain the reference examples that define good output.
Define what must accompany work passed between two specific roles.
Check that arriving work is complete before accepting it.
Convert a vague request into a restatement the requester confirms before work starts.
Decide in advance what would make us stop, while judgement is still uncommitted.
Turn a lesson into a constraint that prevents the repeat automatically.
Connect the top-level goal to metrics each domain can actually move.
Keep unresolved questions alive across handoffs instead of dropping them.
Design the rhythm of planning, review, and decision for the organisation.
Keep one prioritised list for the whole organisation so domains cannot each claim top priority.
Find what can run at the same time and what genuinely cannot.
Find repeating structures in outcomes, failures, or requests.
Break a tie or a 'everything is critical' deadlock into a decision.
Catch quality drops when a prompt, skill, or agent definition changes.

Follow escalations and blockers through to an actual outcome.
Decide which agents and budget go to which bets this cycle.
Run a cycle review that changes behaviour instead of producing notes.

Trace a failure back to the cause that can actually be changed.

Write a procedure another agent can execute without asking questions.

Decide whether a venture stage is complete and what happens next.
